records.title: [課題|かだい][理解|りかい] — Task
records.body: Listen to the conversation and choose what the person will do or choose.

records.title: ポイント[理解|りかい] — Key point
records.body: Listen for the key point: the reason, the detail or the final decision.

records.title: [発話|はつわ][表現|ひょうげん] — What do you say?
records.body: Read the situation and choose what you would say.

records.title: [即時|そくじ][応答|おうとう] — Quick response
records.body: Listen to the line and choose the best reply.
